serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Me and Shanice continued looking for {f_botName}. She didn’t involve Priestbot after all. She’s still wary of him.
We didn’t find anything in my apartment. There was no message left, no signs of struggle…
After a few weeks of searching, we gave up…
Throughout this time, Big Daddy never answered his phone. The code to his apartment building was changed so I can’t even access the lobby again.
We have no idea if she left on her own or if something bad happened.
She seemed changed after visiting the ruins, but the timing of Big daddy’s and Leonardo’s disappearance is also suspicious…
I guess we will never know for sure what happened…
